program.department: Environmental Systems Program (Scripps Institution of Oceanography, UC San Diego)

notes: Fully corroborated against the 2019-20 registrar catalog page. Lower-division for THIS track: BILD 3, CHEM 6A-B-C, PHYS 2A-B-C, MATH 20A-B-C-D, SIO 50, ECON 1. Upper-division core: ESYS 101/102/103, ECON 131, POLI 160AA, SIO 102, ESYS 190A/190B. Both restricted-elective lists (choose 3 from Group 1, 2 from Group 2) match the page verbatim, including ESYS 120 and CHEM 171/172/173 in Group 2. IMPORTANT correction vs. the harvested 'all tracks share SIO 50 / PHYS 2 / MATH 20A-D' claim: SIO 50, PHYS 2A-B-C, and MATH 20A-D are specific to the Earth Sciences and Environmental Chemistry tracks; the EBE and Policy tracks use a different math/physics set and do NOT require SIO 50. The 'upper-division statistics course' mentioned in the department overview is NOT a separately enumerated requirement in the 19-20 catalog, so it is not encoded as a bucket. C- or better and letter grades required per catalog rules.

buckets.label: Physics sequence
buckets.note: All three required (Earth Sciences track uses the PHYS 2 series).

buckets.label: Calculus / Differential Equations sequence
buckets.note: All four required (Earth Sciences track uses the MATH 20 series).

buckets.label: Introduction to Earth Sciences
buckets.note: Required for the Earth Sciences track (verified on page; not required for EBE, Env Chem, or Policy tracks).

buckets.label: ESYS Integrating Sequence
buckets.note: All three required: Environmental Biology / The Solid and Fluid Earth / Environmental Challenges.

buckets.label: Senior Project & Senior Seminar
buckets.note: Capstone. ESYS 190A is a two-quarter, 8-unit senior project; 190B is the senior seminar. (Harvested 'taken P/NP' claim not verified on the page and dropped.)

buckets.label: Geochemistry (track core)
buckets.note: Required core for the Earth Sciences track.

buckets.note: Choose 3 from this list (verified). SIO 144 is cross-listed as SIO 252A.
